tasks.label: STA: Smart Timing Check
tasks.command: source .venv/bin/activate && yosys -p 'read_verilog -sv rtl/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.sv; synth -top ${fileBasenameNoExtension}; dfflibmap -liberty lib/NangateOpenCellLibrary_typical.lib; abc -liberty lib/NangateOpenCellLibrary_typical.lib; clean; write_verilog outputs/${fileBasenameNoExtension}_netlist.v' && export TOP_MODULE=${fileBasenameNoExtension} && sta sta/run_sta.tcl
